title: OrchestraDesignResourceGraph
description: Canonical Draft-07 JSON Schema for Orchestra V3 Design Resource Graph, validating capability routes, domain clusters, and execution phases.

version.description: Semantic versioning of the design resource graph

description.description: Summary of the graph and ecosystem scope

domains.description: Dictionary of functional domain clusters mapping domain names to lists of resource identifiers

capabilities.description: Dictionary of task archetype capabilities mapping lifecycle phases to domains or concrete resources

name.description: Human-readable display name for the capability

description.description: Detailed explanation of the capability archetype

trigger_tags.description: Routing keywords that trigger this capability

discovery.description: Phase 1: Visual and technical research domains or resources queried before implementation

reverse_engineering.description: Phase 1b (Optional): CLI tools for extracting design systems from reference URLs

synthesis.description: Phase 2: Design system definition, typography standards, and architectural contracts

implementation.description: Phase 3: Runtime code dependencies, component primitives, and motion libraries

optional_extensions.description: Phase 3b (Optional): Conditional add-ons (WebGL, sensory, audio, security)

qa.description: Phase 4: Automated visual verification, browser testing, performance, and security gates

anti_patterns.description: Explicitly forbidden design choices, libraries, or architectural anti-patterns
